verdicts.why: In You Know My Steez Misty arrests Mariah for Cornell Stokes's murder and Mariah is freed without charges after Shades, on his own, lures Candace Miller with Misty's phone and kills her.
You Know My Steez has Shades text Candace Miller from Misty's lost phone and kill her to make the evidence against Mariah useless; Misty has not hunted him for years.
Episode 1 has Bruno make her photon gloves and take her to AvengerCon; training her powers, deducing they come from within her and his jealousy over Kamran are episode 2.
Nakia is in episode 1, but she and Bruno only help Kamala stall Damage Control at the school, where the agents arrest them, in episode 6.
Deever answers to P. Cleary, who calls off the operation and relieves her of duty, so she is not the chief.
Episode 1 has G'iah pass Talos the Unity Day plan; in episode 3 Gravik reveals he knows she is the traitor and shoots her; she kills him in episode 6.

Episode 1 has G'iah tell Talos the bomb plan Fury tries to stop; Fury meets her in London in episode 5 to tell her Talos is dead and learns of the Harvest; she poses as Fury against Gravik in episode 6.
Rhodes is first shown to be the Skrull Raava in episode 4 (church meeting with Varra); Fury kills her and the real Rhodes is freed from the New Skrullos pods in episode 6.
Episode 1 has Muneeba refuse AvengerCon; she accepts Kamala's powers in Karachi in episode 5 and gives her the suit in episode 6.
Episode 1 only has Deever and Cleary watch the AvengerCon video (Kamala is masked there); Zoe coins Night Light and Deever's agents chase Kamala after the mosque rescue in episode 2.
Episode 1 has Yusuf ready to go as the Hulk; the rooftop talk where Kamal means marvel and he calls her his little Ms. Marvel is episode 6.
Kamala saves Zoe in episode 1; Zoe joins her at the school saying she owes her for saving her life and livestreams asking followers for help in episode 6.
The three were friends as children before Zoe changed; Nakia and Zoe fight Damage Control together and post a video as friends again in episode 6.
Raava is revealed in episode 4, where she orders Varra to kill Fury and threatens to leak the footage of Gravik killing Hill in Fury's form; Fury shoots her in front of Ritson in episode 6.
Yusuf tells Tyesha the story of Sana following the stars to her father at the dinner in episode 2, Crushed.
In Prague Betty and Ned are stranded on the Ferris wheel when the Fire Elemental scares off the operator, and Peter as Night Monkey saves them, not Beck.
In episode 3 Wong first steps through a portal into GLK&H, then later testifies at the hearing, so they do not meet there.
May injects the Goblin, then the Goblin Glider stabs her in the side and his pumpkin bombs go off; he does not beat her.
After the power-line fight Peter teleports Electro to a Sanctum cell; the cure comes only later at Happy's condo.

In #2 Alexandra only reasons the wall is a door needing a key; in #3 she demands the Iron Fist's location from Stick, mocks Danny about K'un-Lun at Midland Circle and sends Elektra to kill everyone but him; in #6 Elektra brings him captive and she says he will serve her.
In #6 the Hand leaders receive Sowande's head (Alexandra: delivered by Stick) and Bakuto is horrified; no scene shows Sowande reviving Bakuto.

proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Misty's close friend, who helps her learn to fight with one arm.

proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A friend Misty brings police backing to help against Davos.

split.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who helps Misty stop Walker.

verdicts.why: In War Without End Misty contacts Danny and Colleen about her police backing and brings Choi, then heads to Eden Towers to rescue Joy, where Walker knocks her out; the source does not put her at the community center fight, and the S2#10 split is right.
In Take Shelter Sowande frees himself, strikes Danny in a pressure point and holds a glass shard to his throat before Stick beheads him.
Episode 1 shows the lunches and the son's photo; Bucky tells Yori the truth about his son's death in episode 6.
The mid-credits man in a green cloak holding a metal mask is identified as Doom only off-screen, and the owner rule bars naming Doom in First Steps.
Episode 1 is the Tunisia rescue; Batroc joins the Flag Smashers at the end of episode 5 and attacks Sam at the GRC in episode 6, where Sam leaves the fight to stop the helicopter.
Sharon never deals with Karli on screen before episode 6, where she offers her work again, Batroc deduces she is the Power Broker, Karli realizes he was hired to spy on her, and Sharon kills Karli.
Episode 1 is the boat and loan; Sarah tells Sam she has always been proud of him and not to let Isaiah's words decide for him in episode 5.

In #8 Misty fights Bakuto upstairs with Colleen and Claire and loses her arm while Jessica is in the cavern; nothing passes between Misty and Jessica in that episode, and her stalling the police is already in the #7 stage.
Fish in the Jailhouse has Misty interrogate Matt and the others at the precinct and agree at Midland Circle to stall the NYPD; she fights only in #8, upstairs.
In Take Shelter Murakami ambushes from the roof, Stick fights with the group and opens the drain so they escape through the sewers; no one is held in Murakami's grasp.
Sue returns with another book to find a man in a green cloak with a metal mask sitting with Franklin; Doom is named only off-screen.
Dar-Benn is not at the Khan home fight; she first sees Kamala's band on Aladna and demands it, and at Earth's sun takes Kamala hostage under her hammer and grabs the bangle.
Frigga teaching Loki magic is sourced only to a Dark World deleted scene and Loki S1#3, neither of which is Thor (2011).
Billy's 'I knew' about the massacre, having told them he wanted no part of it, is in S1#12 Home; at season start he is only the family's close friend.
Two Dead Men has Micro track Castle on cameras and point him to the Zubair disc, and Castle draws him out by getting hit by Sarah's car; the fight and partnership are S1#3.
In Resupply Turk has only a crate of pink guns and no ammo and the Punisher knocks him out; Frank's armory comes from hijacking the DHS-tracked shipment.
Bob is captured and taken to the Watchtower while Alexei's limo picks up the others; Alexei meets him when Valentina unveils the Sentry, admires the name, charges and is punched into a wall.
Ragnarok shows Valkyrie visiting the Hulk's quarters to train and playfully spar; only Valkyrie is shown drinking.
Mel advises Bucky to track her own phone before hanging up.

proposed.text: The White Vision keeps F.R.I.D.A.Y. and other Stark A.I.s inside his Mindspace, where she looks after his social development. She becomes a close friend who helps him in his search to understand humanity.

split.title: VisionQuest#4
split.text: In Vision's Mindspace, F.R.I.D.A.Y. wears the face of Allison Hogan, Howard Stark's office administrator, the woman she was modeled on.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The White Vision, in whose Mindspace F.R.I.D.A.Y. wears Allison Hogan's face.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's old A.I., a close friend in Vision's Mindspace with Allison Hogan's face.

verdicts.why: No Strings has F.R.I.D.A.Y. oversee his social development; Reboot (#3) only reveals the avatars are based on real people in general, and Allison Hogan is first named on screen in #4 (E.D.I.T.H.: 'Howard's Gal Friday, Allison Hogan'), so the split belongs at #4.
Jocasta infects Lisa with a prototype nanobot in Madripoor and Tommy deactivates it in episode 6, Deadlock.

proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The witch Billy follows down the Witches' Road.

split.text: Agatha learns the teen is Wanda's son Billy, reborn in William Kaplan's body, and tells him they must go on together since he cannot control his power.

split.on_b_card_about_a: Learns who Billy is and takes him on down the Witches' Road.

split.text: Agatha helps Billy find Tommy's soul. When Death comes for them, Billy gives Agatha some of his power, and she gives her life in his place.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Wanda's son, reborn as William Kaplan. Agatha dies in his place.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Billy's guide on the Witches' Road. She gives her life for him.

split.title: Agatha All Along#9
split.text: As a ghost, Agatha stays on as Billy's guide, and they set out to find Tommy.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Wanda's son, reborn as William Kaplan. Agatha dies for him, then guides him.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Billy's guide on the Witches' Road. She gives her life for him, then guides him as a ghost.

verdicts.why: The splits are right (ep6 reveal, ep8 Agatha dies after Billy shares his power, ep9 ghost guide), but the episode 1 text named Billy, giving away the episode 6 reveal that Teen is Billy, so it now says 'a teen' (who breaks into Agnes's house in ep1).

proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Wanda's nosy neighbor Agnes, who helps her settle in.

split.text: Agnes reveals herself to Wanda as the witch Agatha Harkness, who has been meddling in her life, from the fake Pietro to Sparky's death.

split.on_b_card_about_a: Wanda's neighbor Agnes, really a witch who has been meddling in her life.

verdicts.why: The splits are right (ep1 Agnes helps her prepare, ep7 reveal, ep9 fight and trap), but the episode 1 text still said 'Agatha Harkness ... as Agnes', giving away the episode 7 reveal, so the base text names only Agnes. (The agatha|billy stage at WandaVision#5 names Agatha the same way, but that pair was not in this batch.)
Agatha All Along ep8 leaves the drowning boy unnamed; the name Thomas Shepherd first comes in VisionQuest #1, and the owner rule bars it before VisionQuest.
The pilot (eps 1-2) does not show Blade beating Chase; in ep6 The Evil Within Marcus sends Chase after the pregnant Vanessa, Blade intercepts Vanessa and defeats Chase.
The conclave is the finale, ep13 Conclave, where Blade launches and shoots open the toxin canister, then duels Marcus with swords.
Mercury attacks Blade and Karen after Pearl and they escape when Whistler arrives; at the temple Karen kills her with Whistler's garlic spray, not Blade.
Conclave (ep13) is the 'final showdown between Marcus and Blade, as well as Krista and Chase'.

After the conclave Marcus works out that Krista has been working for Blade and grabs her by the throat, which is ep13 Conclave. (The stage's title with no #N comes after a #2 stage, which is left to the owner.)
